verdict.rationale: Viam documents remote teleoperation (web-UI driving, gamepad base remote control, a Teleop dashboard) and fleet monitoring and alerting. Nothing in the evidence describes routing autonomy failures into a human intervention queue, or an operator resolving the issue and handing control back to autonomy. Logic modules that fire alerts and manual teleop are adjacent building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can route autonomy failures to a human intervention queue where an operator resolves and hands back control
